task.title: Build native mobile manufacturing app with offline sync
task.description: Create an original native mobile application for manufacturing with offline synchronization capability. This requires native mobile development expertise (iOS/Android) and offline-first architecture experience beyond basic JavaScript UI.

recommendation.reason: Mika can assist with basic UI components and JavaScript logic, but lacks native mobile and offline sync expertise. A specialized Mobile Developer would deliver a production-ready solution with proper native architecture and data synchronization patterns.

alternatives.reason: Custom Mobile Developer specializing in native iOS/Android and offline-first databases (SQLite, Realm) would be the optimal fit for this complex engineering work.
